column3: With respect to the SOA - Rock Island Mortgaged Property (0.6%), the related Mortgaged Property formerly contained a 10,000- gallon steel heating oil underground storage tank (UST) installed in the 1960's, last used in 1974, and excavated and removed from such Mortgaged Property on June 23, 1993. Soil sample results were not included in the environmental review files and the former use and location of the UST was not evaluated. The related ESA concluded that the inability to rule out a potential release of heating oil from the former UST presents a REC. Additionally, an ESA dated December 14, 2021 concluded a REC due to an open collection sump that was identified within the production area of the Tibor Machine Products unit, based on the use of petroleum products and hazardous substances in conjunction with the current on-site operations and lack of maintenance history and lack of soil or groundwater samples. An opinion of probable cost was obtained to quantify the remediation cost for the REC at the SOA – Rock Island Mortgaged Property based on the scope of the Phase II ESA recommendation with a probable low estimate of $19,800 and a probable maximum estimate of $574,200.
